# Rama Sanjaya

> Product engineer in Bandung & Jakarta, Indonesia. Builds data-heavy and AI-driven products end to end: the data pipeline, the matching logic, and the interface.

Rama Sanjaya is a product engineer based in Bandung & Jakarta, Indonesia (GMT+7). He builds products end to end — Python collection pipelines, PostgreSQL lineage, Go matching engines, and SvelteKit interfaces — and is open to remote roles in Singapore, Malaysia and Australia.

## Key facts
- Name: Rama Sanjaya
- Role: Product engineer (applied AI)
- Location: Bandung & Jakarta, Indonesia (GMT+7)
- Current work: BYRIS, a census of 1,170 Indonesian exporters scored against 71,349 evidence rows
- Stack: SvelteKit, TypeScript, Go, PostgreSQL, Python
- Availability: remote roles in Singapore, Malaysia and Australia; contract work
- Email: ramasanjaya3302@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rama-sanjaya22/
- GitHub: https://github.com/Ramasanjaya22
